events.title: Moth Infestation
events.description: Patchwork moths nibble spare seams in the satchel.

choices.text: Feed a spare part to the moths (+2 scraps)
Fumigate the satchel (spend 1 scrap)
Escape before the moths spread

events.title: The Dye Vat
events.description: Indigo thread waits to strengthen a sewn body part.

choices.text: Raise a worn part one tier (spend 3 scraps)
Skim dyed thread (+1 scrap)
Leave the vat

events.title: Frayed Debt Parcel
events.description: Borrowed stitches offer stronger spare parts at a cost to composure.

choices.text: Take a tier II claw (requires DARK or SNUFFED candlelight; the borrowed stitches strain every doll)
Take a tier II moth wing (the borrowed stitches strain every doll)
Gather loose thread (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Needle Toll
events.description: The front living pioneer may pay six HP for a rare spare. Seven HP are required to pay safely.

choices.text: Front living pioneer pays 6 HP for a tier III claw
Pocket loose thread (+1 scrap)

events.title: The Glassfront Pin Cabinet
events.description: A giant glass-front sewing cabinet looms above the doll-sized passage; behind warped panes a plump button-eyed keeper sorts copper pins into black velvet drawers.

choices.text: Open a draughty pin tray (+3 scraps, -8 candle; the cold draft strains every doll)
Spend 2 scraps bracing the candle wick (+15 candle; every doll settles)
Let the cabinet's velvet drawers close

events.title: The Moonblack Paperweight
events.description: A moonblack glass paperweight pins a torn house plan to the floorboards; a small cream-felt mapkeeper waits beneath its cold reflection, holding an ink-stained spool.

choices.text: Pay 16 gold for a reassuring house plan (every doll settles)
Lift the shadowed weight (+23 gold, -10 candle; every doll strains)
Leave the black glass holding down the plan

events.title: The Cinder-Brass Bedwarmer
events.description: A bedwarmer the size of a wagon glows behind a perforated brass lid; a soot-dark round ragdoll steadies its long wooden handle beside a threadbare carpet.

choices.text: When the candle gutters, borrow embers; gain light but strain the dolls
Sift cooling ashes for scraps; dim the candle and calm the dolls
Leave the bedwarmer glowing in the dark

events.title: The Keyhole Choir
events.description: A brass keyhole towers above the doll-sized skirting board. Three round, button-eyed singers sway behind its dark throat, and their humming makes the candle flame bow toward the door.

choices.text: Follow the warm humming; mend the dolls, kindle the wick, strain their seams
Spend scraps to quiet Wren and ease the dolls' seams
Leave the little choir singing behind the door

events.title: The Compass of Loose Ends
events.description: A dinner-plate compass sits on a vast overturned spool. Its needle is a bent knitting pin, turning toward a knot that only the little hooded dolls seem able to read.

choices.text: Let the Yarn Ranger trace the knot (+2 scraps, -9 candle; requires Yarn Ranger)
Trade gold for a quiet bearing to calm the dolls
Leave the needle turning in circles

events.title: The Veiled Wardrobe Mirror
events.description: A wardrobe mirror looms like a silver wall. A small stitched doll in the glass wears a lace veil and copies every movement a heartbeat too late.

choices.text: Pry the silver seam for a rich purse; dim the wick and strain every doll
Pin the veil back with a scrap to soothe the dolls
Pass without looking into the silver again

events.title: The Glass-Eyed Pendulum
events.description: A toppled hall clock blocks the doll-sized corridor. Its pendulum swings past a black glass eye, and a button-eyed keeper holds the wick beneath its ticking teeth.

choices.text: Feed the clock's wick and quiet the dolls
Break off a brass tooth and take its spool
Back away from the ticking glass

events.title: The Skirting Listening Shell
events.description: A pale spiral shell is sewn into the tall skirting board. Four little voices whisper from its mouth while the corridor candle bends toward the wall.

choices.text: Let the Lantern Monk answer the whisper
Pay to quiet the voices
Leave the shell to whisper

events.title: The Hushed Birdcage
events.description: A brass birdcage hangs from a splintered bedroom beam above the little corridor. Inside, a stuffed canary with a crooked button eye grips a silent bell while warm thread drips from its perch.

choices.text: Let the Tinker free the bell and pocket its loose stitches
Spend scraps to keep the bird's light and ease the dolls' dread
Pass beneath the quiet cage

events.title: The Rocking Horse Vigil
events.description: An enormous painted rocking horse blocks the nursery door. Its cloth mane has come unstitched, its bell-metal shoe taps the boards, and a tiny round ragdoll keeps watch beside its broken reins.

choices.text: Let the Seamstress sew the reins to comfort and mend the dolls
Pull free the metal shoe for gold, losing light and calm
Let the horse rock without another sound

events.title: The Frosted Attic Porthole
events.description: A round frosted attic window glows above the skirting. A plump felt nightwatcher holds a candle below its star-shaped cracks while an old blackout curtain shivers without wind.

choices.text: Let the Lantern Monk guard the wick and settle Wren's fear
Pay for the curtain lining to quiet the dolls at the cost of light
Leave the frost on the glass

events.title: The Ashglass Metronome
events.description: A towering metronome sways in a torn velvet wall niche. Its black glass weight holds a trapped candle-glow while the Tinker's crooked gears tick in sympathy.

choices.text: Let the Tinker retime the hot weight and steady Wren.
Crack the glass for loose brass while the light stumbles.
Let the metronome count the quiet again.

events.title: The Black-Velvet Millwheel
events.description: A dinner-table-sized toy mill grinds old stitches beside the skirting. A velvet doll keeper holds its cracked spokes as the Seamstress studies the loose binding.

choices.text: Let the Seamstress bind the wheel and mend tired dolls.
Steal the silver pinion, darkening the road ahead.
Leave the mill to grind its own ragged thread.

events.title: The Cinder-Iron Bootscraper
events.description: A vast iron bootscraper juts from a soot-stained threshold, its blunt teeth crowded with torn doll-straw. Beyond it a weak amber glow slips under the door.

choices.text: Let the Scarecrow pack its teeth and shield the flame.
Pull free the rusted teeth; the dolls pay in stuffing.
Step around the iron teeth and keep walking.
